svg.text: Front view of the device on a DIN rail, each module shown with its cover removed to expose the electronics. Every module has its own enclosure, and works
standalone on 5–32 V DC or USB-C 5 V. Each module has its own power stage; an optional plug-in battery + charger board per module. Not to scale.

Gold = SMA antenna connector · grey strips = screw terminals · ∥ = diode-ORed supplies · D-x
• Reliability and safety before cost (COMP-5). Ethernet only through a MAC inside the host chip. No Mornsun parts. Modules run on safe low voltage; only relay contacts
may switch mains, behind 5 kV reinforced isolation.
• Every module: its own power stage on its PCB (input protection, OR, buck to 5 V + 3.3 V, PWR-10) and optionally a plug-in battery + charger board with an 18650 cell
(PWR-2); each module reports its type, hardware revision and serial over the stack bus (no ID EEPROM); a hung module is reset by its own watchdog.
• No baseboard: every module is standalone; in a stack the coordinator is elected Fieldbus controller > Wi-Fi + BLE > LoRa; any module may feed bus power. Each module can
take its own battery + charger board (PWR-2). 4G industrial router (RUT200 class): separate product, page 7.
• Parts are research proposals, not frozen: confirm stock and 100-unit quotes first.
